summary: Frontend-only verification of stale-response race fix in AdminGithubBulkRevoke.jsx (loadSeqRef sequence guard). All 3 race/regression tests PASS. Test 4 (route-loader hang) NOT reproducible in this run.

tests_executed.TEST_1_normal_tab_cycling: PASS — Revokable, Idle, Stuck, All tabs each cleared 'Loading…' and rendered content under normal network conditions.
tests_executed.TEST_2_race_condition_repro: PASS — With page.route() delaying GET /admin/github/connections* by 5s, navigated fresh to /admin/github-bulk-revoke, clicked Stuck tab immediately. Stuck tab rendered rows within ~0.25s. After waiting 7s past the delayed revokable response landing, Stuck tab still shows rows correctly (stuck_row present, loading NOT visible). loadSeqRef guard confirmed working — stale response discarded.
tests_executed.TEST_3_reverse_race_rapid_switching: PASS — Rapid switching stuck→revokable→idle→all→stuck settled cleanly on final tab (stuck), loading cleared, correct data rendered.
tests_executed.TEST_4_route_loader_hang: NOT REPRODUCIBLE — /login and /admin/github-bulk-revoke loaded normally in this fresh browser session; no >10s Suspense fallback observed. Likely a transient issue in the main agent's earlier session.

note_route_path: The actual route path is /admin/github-bulk-revoke (single hyphenated segment), not /admin/github/bulk-revoke as stated in the review request. Confirmed via App.jsx line 464 and adminNav.js. Tests were run against the correct path.
action_items: MINOR: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires when rendering Stuck tab and All tab tables on /admin/github-bulk-revoke. Duplicate React key warning present on this page — consider auditing row .map() key props.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Race-condition fix verified live via network throttling. If revisiting, note: (a) correct route is /admin/github-bulk-revoke, (b) test creds test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026!, (c) there is one 'Redirected, no follow-up' stuck row (fresh-funnel-0824@aurem.dev) present in the seeded env, (d) a duplicate React key warning was seen — separate minor issue.
rca of the issue: Root cause was correctly diagnosed by main agent: shared load() in AdminGithubBulkRevoke.jsx did not guard against out-of-order async resolution. When the slow /admin/github/connections?view=revokable request resolved after a user-initiated tab switch, its trailing setRowsView('revokable') overwrote the fast Stuck response's state, causing showingStaleOrLoading (loading || rowsView !== view) to permanently mismatch. Fix — loadSeqRef useRef sequence number, incremented per call and re-checked after each await — ensures only the latest load()'s result is applied. Verified live: even with a 5s artificial delay on the revokable endpoint, the Stuck tab renders in <0.3s and remains rendered after the stale response lands.
